findings.detail: The extracted Twin Star International 06/18/21 Term Loan row has blank interest_rate even though the source states 12.89% inc PIK.

rationale: The X02 flag concerns a private credit row with missing interest_rate/basis_spread. The matching SOI row for Twin Star International, acquisition date 06/18/21, Term Loan, maturity 06/18/26 discloses a rate of 12.89% inc PIK with all PIK terms. Because the stored observed value is blank while the raw source contains a stated rate, the flag is a real extraction gap.
